Homelab 1.6.4 — First Release

Forked from an open-source Homelab client with the following additions:

New Features

- New Home Dashboard with system health, Docker containers, and qBittorrent cards
- Integrate OpenList player (VLCKit) for video playback
- Add CloudSaver media module with poster search and one-tap transfer
- Add Arcane interactive terminal (SwiftTerm) and container management
- Enhance qBittorrent details with Tracker and rate-limit management
- Add one-tap LAN vs. remote network mode
- Add bulk host replacement in Settings and external subtitle support
- Liquid Glass visual polish across the app

> Note: IPA is signed with a free Apple ID (development profile, expires 2026-08-12). Refresh via SideStore/AltStore after expiry.

---

Homelab 1.6.4 — 首个正式发布

本项目 fork 自开源 Homelab 客户端，在此基础上新增了以下功能：

新增功能

- 全新首页仪表盘：系统健康、Docker 容器、qBittorrent 卡片
- 集成 OpenList 播放器（VLCKit），支持视频播放
- 新增 CloudSaver 影视模块：海报搜索、一键转存
- 新增 Arcane 交互式终端（SwiftTerm）及容器管理
- 增强 qBittorrent 详情：Tracker 与限速管理
- 新增局域网/远程网络模式一键切换
- 设置中批量替换主机地址、支持外挂字幕
- Liquid Glass 视觉打磨

> 注意：IPA 使用免费 Apple ID 签名（development profile，2026-08-12 到期），到期后请通过 SideStore/AltStore 刷新。
